title: quelda scan line
description: One line of `quelda scan` output for a folder or several files (`--format jsonl`): one file and its verdict. Version 1.

file.description: The path as given on the command line, joined with the path inside the folder (absolute with --absolute); "-" for stdin.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file; null with --no-hash, or when the file could not be read or is larger than limits.max_file_bytes and came from a pipe.
